messages:
maria: Drafted two benchmark narratives for the launch — need quick takes before I lock them for the website + webinar landing. TL;DR: one is a latency-first story, the other is a cost-first story. Which resonates more for PLG devs?

aj: can you paste the short intros here?
maria: sure — latency-first: \"Predictable latency at scale: how we keep tail p99s low while serving many concurrent sessions, with fallbacks and shard routing. Includes latency-by-model charts and regional failover case.\" cost-first: \"Cost per useful token: strategies to cut unit spend via batching, KV cache, and quantized variants without hurting output quality. Includes per-workload econ slices and savings calc.\"
taylor: both sound solid. for devs I think the latency story sells reliability -> adoption. costs matter later when they scale. maybe lead with latency in the hero and surface cost savings as a follow-up section. :thumbsup:
sam: agree with taylor. also suggest a combined graphic that shows a simple tradeoff curve: latency (ms) on X, cost ($/k tokens) on Y, with annotated points for hosted/dedicated/private deployments. makes the tradeoffs tangible.
maria: love the curve idea. would that be too abstract for the landing page?
aj: not if we add concrete example points: e.g., 8ms/10¢ per 1k tokens (hosted), 12ms/6¢ (dedicated), 25ms/3¢ (private quantized). real numbers from perf deck.
taylor: +1. Also add a small inset: \"when to pick which\" — quick bullets for PLG, enterprise, regulated. helps inbound routing (we can tag leads by which point they click).
sam: speaking of routing — product wants us to pass lead signals via the form: deployment preference, expected qps, and cost sensitivity. we can wire that to the SDR queue.
maria: can design do a fast mock for the curve + 3-point inset? we need assets by EOD for the webinar page. @design-bot can you generate a 2up of hero + inset in Figma?
design-bot: created a draft file: https://figma.com/file/xyz/bench-curve-mock — comments enabled. placed 2 variants: bold-hero & soft-hero.
aj: nice — will review. also we should prepare two webinar hooks in copy: 1) \"Keeping user experiences snappy at scale\" (latency lead) and 2) \"Cut your inference bill without losing quality\" (cost lead). test both in ads.
taylor: for A/B we'll need two landing CTAs and separate tracking params. marketing ops to set up campaigns and inbound routing by CTA.
maria: final ask: can we get a 1-slide summary of the tradeoff curve + 3 bullets for each deployment by noon? I can pre-write the webinar description once I see the slide.
sam: I'll handle the routing rules with ops — set SDR tags: \"latency-first\", \"cost-first\", \"ops/private\" based on the form and clicked CTA.
aj: quick note — include a short calc snippet for the blog showing how batching + cache reduces cost:
```
Example: 100 QPS, 1k tokens avg, batching = 5 -> effective token compute drops 80%, cost/1M tokens goes from $100 -> $20 (approx)
```
maria: perfect. thanks everyone — catching design + ops reviews now. will post back with the chosen hero by 2pm. :rocket:
